aggregation.title: Kemn Ljemr - Artist announcements
aggregation.reason: The four distinct artist announcements share the same promotional design. They are displayed as one curated collection, not four visually repetitive cards.
aggregation.note: The collection uses the first original post ID and representative source link; it is not presented as a new Instagram post. Each media item retains its own original source URL and credit.

aggregation.preservation: All four distinct videos, their posters and both unique still images retain their original local asset paths.

deduplication.method: SHA-256 equality of existing WebP files, plus visual review of poster and decoded video frames. Distinct performer reels and their original source attribution are retained within the announcements collection.
